entities.summary: Anthony Camara is a Canadian professional ice hockey player. He is currently playing with Iserlohn Roosters in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Camara was selected by the Boston Bruins in the 3rd round of the 2011 NHL Entry Draft.
